title: Manual governance
purpose: How the manual works: its scope, its place beside the Subcontractor Agreement, the order of precedence, the controls every module carries, and the acknowledgement.

title: Site Manager role
purpose: What the Site Manager owns, supports, reports and escalates, under five stable headings.

title: Pre-start and mobilisation
purpose: Office pre-start, site mobilisation and compliance readiness in one workflow, closed by written confirmation to the Project Manager.

title: Site setup
purpose: Everything physically in place before works commence: what the Site Manager confirms, what the H&S Officer supplies, what comes from the yard and what comes from suppliers.

title: Daily site routine
purpose: Start of day, through the day, daily reporting, end of day, and what is never done.

title: Weekly and monthly routine
purpose: The Friday close-out, the weekly project meeting, the weekly and monthly H&S cycle and the attendance record.

title: Reporting matrix
purpose: What is sent, when, to whom and by what route — including the invoice and attendance routes.

title: Variation workflow
purpose: Raising a Variation the same day it is identified: the trigger, the inputs, the email format and the approval gate.

title: Request for Information workflow
purpose: Raising an RFI the same day: who it is for, what it carries and where it goes.

title: Change Order workflow
purpose: A change to scope, sequence or specification that affects time or cost, raised as a Change Order and approved in writing before proceeding.

title: Materials and deliveries
purpose: Planning a week ahead, ordering on trade accounts, the collections rule and the approved suppliers.

title: Waste and muck-away
purpose: Skip bookings, muck-away lorries and the notification to the Project Manager before cost is committed.

title: Plant hire and off-hire
purpose: Quotes and sign-off, logging and inspection on delivery, care during the hire, and off-hire the day it is no longer needed.

title: Emergency labour
purpose: Agency labour when booked labour lets the site down: the process, the approved agencies and the email format.

title: Company Card and Dext
purpose: What the Company Card is for, the rules that come from the Agreement, the sign-off threshold, and receipts through Dext and Ringo.

title: Vehicle care
purpose: Standards for a Company van, the weekly checks and the recovery of costs where they are not kept.

title: Site standards
purpose: The Jewel Standard for protection, cleanliness, security and branding, with the appendix references for external protection, separation and dust exclusion, internal protection and welfare.

title: Health and safety framework
purpose: The Site Manager's daily, weekly and monthly H&S actions and records, and the framework groups the H&S Officer owns.

title: Substitutes and data handling
purpose: Sending a substitute under clause 2.3(f) of the Agreement, and the practical handling of Company and Client Information under clause 22.

title: Forms and registers
purpose: Every live form and register: where it lives, who fills it and when.

title: Key contacts
purpose: The office, its inboxes, the approved suppliers, the approved agencies and the H&S contacts.
